title: Financial Regulatory Bodies: SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA & IFSCA
summary: India's financial regulatory architecture assigns sectoral authority to SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, and IFSCA, coordinated by the Financial Stability and Development Council.

blocks.title: First-Principles Core Truth
blocks.summary: India's financial regulatory architecture assigns sectoral authority to SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, and IFSCA, coordinated by the Financial Stability and Development Council.

blocks.content: 1. SEBI (SEBI Act 1992): Regulates Securities and Capital Markets, Mutual Funds, Stock Exchanges (NSE/BSE), and FPIs.
2. IRDAI & PFRDA: IRDAI (Act 1999 - Malhotra Committee - Insurance sector) | PFRDA (Act 2013 - National Pension System NPS & Pension sector).
3. IFSCA (IFSCA Act 2019): International Financial Services Centres Authority. Unified regulator for offshore financial services in GIFT City Gujarat.
4. FSDC (Dec 2010): Financial Stability and Development Council. Apex non-statutory body chaired by **Union Finance Minister** to resolve inter-regulatory conflicts.

blocks.text:
⚡ 1. Primary Financial Regulators Summary Table
| Regulator | Statutory Act & Year | Primary Sectoral Jurisdiction | Headquarters |
|---|---|---|---|
| **RBI** | RBI Act 1934 | Monetary Policy, Banking System, Payment Systems, Forex | Mumbai |
| **SEBI** | SEBI Act 1992 | Capital Markets, Stock Exchanges, Mutual Funds, Commodities | Mumbai |
| **IRDAI** | IRDAI Act 1999 | Insurance and Reinsurance companies | **Hyderabad** |
| **PFRDA** | PFRDA Act 2013 | Pension Sector, National Pension System (NPS) | New Delhi |
| **IFSCA** | IFSCA Act 2019 | Offshore International Financial Services Centres (GIFT City) | **GIFT City, Gandhinagar** |

📖 2. Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC)
- **Establishment:** Set up in December 2010 based on **Raghuram Rajan Committee** recommendations.
- **Chairperson:** **Union Finance Minister**.
- **Members:** RBI Governor, SEBI Chairman, IRDAI Chairman, PFRDA Chairman, IFSCA Chairman, Finance Secretary, Chief Economic Adviser.
- **Sub-Committee of FSDC:** Chaired by **RBI Governor**.

⚖️ 3. Common Prelims & Mains Traps
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 1:** The Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) is chaired by the **Union Finance Minister**, but its Sub-Committee is chaired by the **RBI Governor**!
- ⚠️ **Exam Trap 2:** IRDAI headquarters is located in **Hyderabad** (not Mumbai or Delhi!). IFSCA headquarters is in **GIFT City, Gandhinagar**.

blocks.content:
#### Tier 1 — Recall MCQ
**Q:** Who officially serves as the Chairperson of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC)?  
(A) Governor of the Reserve Bank of India  
(B) Chairman of SEBI  
(C) Union Minister of Finance  
(D) Prime Minister of India  
**Answer: — FSDC is chaired by Union Finance Minister.

#### Tier 2 — Applied Scenario
**Scenario:** A financial firm in GIFT City Gujarat offers combined offshore banking, securities trading, and insurance products to non-resident clients. Which single unified regulator oversees all these operations?  
**Resolution:IFSCA** (International Financial Services Centres Authority), established as a unified regulator for IFSCs under the IFSCA Act 2019.

#### Tier 3 — Mains Descriptive Prompt
*'Outline the jurisdictional structure of India's statutory financial regulators (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, PFRDA, IFSCA). How does FSDC resolve inter-regulatory conflicts?'*
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Master the distinctions between monetary policy tools (Repo vs Reverse Repo, MSF, SDF) and fiscal deficit calculation formulas.
